card.title: How To Repair iPhone 12 Pro Max No Audio

source.title: How To Repair iPhone 12 Pro Max No Audio

claims.statement: iPhone 12 Pro Max with no bottom loudspeaker and no Taptic vibration, unchanged by new speaker, new Taptic and both new amp ICs, was fixed by replacing the Sakonnet IC U8400.

procedure: Inspect around amps and U8400; check OEM speaker/Taptic.
Test known-good speaker and Taptic Engine.
Replace U8400 (reballed donor); test speaker and haptics.
card.caveats: Same U8400 designator is blamed for similar symptoms on iPhone 13. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
